summary: Itaú Unibanco Holding S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a Public Access Report on its Social, Environmental and Climate Risk Policy. The document sets out purpose, target audience, definitions, principles, and governance for managing social, environmental, and climate (SEC) risks across the bank and its subsidiaries, in compliance with Brazilian CMN Resolutions 4,557/17, 4,943/21, and 4,945/21. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation, or structural event is disclosed; this is a routine policy disclosure with no special-situation or risk-arb angle.
